title: Clawk – Give coding agents a disposable Linux VM, not your laptop
claim: Show HN: Clawk – Give coding agents a disposable Linux VM, not your laptop
why_good: Gives coding agents a disposable Linux VM instead of your laptop — the safe-sandbox need every serious agent user hits.
value: Usage-based ephemeral-VM service for agent devs/teams (the E2B lane); pay per VM-hour, enterprise isolation.
risk: E2B, Modal, Daytona and the labs are racing on agent sandboxes; needs a speed, cost or DX edge to stand out.

zh.claim: Show HN: Clawk —— 给编码 agent 一台一次性 Linux VM,而不是你的笔记本。
zh.why_good: 给编码 agent 一台一次性 Linux VM 而非你的笔记本——每个认真的 agent 用户都会撞上的安全沙箱需求。
zh.value: 给 agent 开发者/团队做按量的临时 VM 服务(E2B 赛道):按 VM 小时计费、企业隔离。
zh.risk: E2B、Modal、Daytona 和各实验室都在抢 agent 沙箱;要靠速度、成本或体验优势才突出。

pick_reason: Clawk addresses a clear need for secure coding environments, with potential for monetization through subscriptions or usage fees.
